Provides detailed output with function names

patterns_discovered.description: Creating standalone verification scripts to validate refactoring success
patterns_discovered.value: Provides immediate confidence that imports and URL routing work after structural changes

patterns_discovered.description: Views are grouped into categories: Stock, Movement, Warehouse, Reservation, Count
patterns_discovered.value: Improves code organization and makes relationship between views explicit

patterns_discovered.description: Both scripts use emoji indicators (✅/❌) and detailed messages for readability
patterns_discovered.value: Makes test results immediately scannable and user-friendly

patterns_discovered.description: Scripts properly initialize Django environment before importing models/views
patterns_discovered.value: Ensures scripts can run standalone without application context

gotchas_discovered.description: Script tests successful import but doesn't validate view functionality
gotchas_discovered.impact: Imports working doesn't guarantee views work correctly in URL routing or execution
gotchas_discovered.mitigation: Combined with verify_urls.py for more complete verification

gotchas_discovered.description: verify_urls.py assumes specific Django app namespace 'inventory:'
gotchas_discovered.impact: Script will fail if URL configuration doesn't use this namespace
gotchas_discovered.mitigation: Hard-coded namespace is appropriate for single app verification

gotchas_discovered.impact: If views are added/removed, counts in print statements become inaccurate
gotchas_discovered.mitigation: Counts should be auto-calculated rather than hard-coded for maintainability

deliverables: verify_urls.py - Tests 6 URL routes and view resolution

recommendations.recommendation: Dynamically calculate and display view counts instead of hard-coding numbers
recommendations.rationale: Prevents stale count information when views are added/removed

recommendations.recommendation: Add functional verification beyond imports (e.g., test view execution with mock requests)
recommendations.rationale: Current verification only confirms imports work, not that views execute correctly

recommendations.recommendation: Document expected view count per category in code comments
recommendations.rationale: Makes it easier to verify completeness during future refactoring

recommendations.recommendation: Consider integrating these verification checks into CI/CD pipeline
recommendations.rationale: Ensures refactoring validation runs automatically on every commit

recommendations.recommendation: Add more granular error reporting (e.g., which view failed to import)
recommendations.rationale: Current error handling is generic; specific failures would be easier to debug
